race.description: Book Your Christmas Parties 10th Dec 2026 Mdn Hcp
race.comment: The well-related STAFFO (8) (half to G3 winner Shamalia) wasn't disgraced finishing fifth at her latest appearance over 1300m at Toowoomba. Rock-hard fit for this and gets some weight relief with the 2kg claim. Suited in this line-up and is among the better hopes. MISSION WISE (3) finished eighth, beaten 6 lengths, when resuming from a spell last start over 1300m at Hawkesbury. Will find this assignment much easier. Definite top-three hope with plenty of improvement to come. ROYAL DIPLOMAT (4) is a maiden galloper resuming from a spell after finishing sixth over 1400m at Sunshine Coast at the latest appearance on January 11. Fitter for two trials, placing most recently. Key runner while fresh. HE'S A FIGHTER (5) will appreciate the longer journey after finishing a solid sixth when resuming last start over 1050m at Rockhampton. Backmarker who gets home hard. Best form puts him right in this.
